# From a rectangle to a circle

<!-- STEP id="polygon" -->
An athlete runs round a rectangular track at a steady speed. On each straight side, her direction stays the same. She changes direction 4 times in each round. On a track with six sides, she changes direction 6 times.

<!-- STEP id="circle" -->
Now add more and more sides. Each side gets shorter, and she turns more often. In the end the track becomes a circle, and the direction of her velocity changes all the time.
